scope: exploratory retrospective subsequent-window risk accuracy; not an untouched holdout or historically implementable forecast
incomplete_window_policy: log and exclude mechanically; never shorten horizon
timing_rule: close of first XNYS session strictly after SEC acceptance local date; explicit AI-assisted assumption, not approved execution eligibility
primary_loss: squared error of equal-weight daily portfolio variance against centered next-21-session sample covariance, ddof=1
secondary_losses: mean squared covariance-entry error over all n*n entries
mean squared covariance-entry error over off-diagonal entries
aggregate: equal mean of window losses; improvement=1-model_mean_loss/price_only_mean_loss; no tuning, selection or significance tests
realized_proxy: centered sample covariance, ddof=1, next 21 daily Yahoo adjusted-price proxy returns
level_control: at primary weight only, replace K by (1-c)I+c11T where c is its mean off-diagonal cosine; equal score level, no company-specific structure
chronology_limit: November embeddings and unknown training cutoffs; source identities and eligibility assumptions remain AI-assisted. Prior November snapshot included these price dates.
